kol.via_en: a16z · The State of AI: Macro, Apps, and Consumer
kol.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol.take_zh: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol.detail: Anish Acharya joins Jen Kha to break down the next frontier of AI, from the evolving model landscape and open-source AI to why the application layer, and consumer AI in particular, may be entering a new phase. Anish explains why he believes there will be multiple winners at the model layer, why traditional moats like network effects, scale, and brand still matter, and how companies can choose between frontier and open-weight models depending on the economics of the task. They also explore why models are increasingly specializing, and how applications can combine different types of intelligence...
kol.detail_zh: Anish Acharya 与 Jen Kha 在 a16z 节目中讨论了 AI 的下一个前沿：模型格局的演变、开源 AI 的兴起，以及应用层——尤其是消费者 AI——可能进入新阶段。他指出模型层将出现多赢格局，网络效应、规模和品牌等传统护城河仍然重要，企业应根据任务的经济性在前沿模型与开放权重模型之间做选择；同时，模型正在专业化，应用可以整合不同类型的智能。

kol.take: 模型商业化要看真实路由和 $ spend 份额，而不是只看 benchmark；渠道份额能更早暴露谁在生产流量里变现。
kol.take_en: Model monetization is better tracked through real routing and $ spend share than benchmarks; channel share reveals who is monetizing production traffic.
kol.take_zh: AI Gateway 新增在长时间生成结束后触发 webhook 的功能，既能避免长时间闲置的计算开销，又提升了可靠性，使网关能够承担更多处理负荷。用户可在 “use workflow” 中通过 await hook() 合理消费这些回调，从而实现资源利用的更高效。
kol.detail: AI Gateway can now call webhooks after long generations 😍 ① Lower compute costs (no long-running process waiting idly) ② More reliable. Gateway can take more of the processing burden ③ You can 𝚊𝚠𝚊𝚒𝚝 𝚑𝚘𝚘𝚔() in "𝚞𝚜𝚎 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚠" to sanely consume these
kol.detail_zh: AI Gateway 新增在长时间生成结束后触发 webhook 的功能，既能避免长时间闲置的计算开销，又提升了可靠性，使网关能够承担更多处理负荷。用户可在 “use workflow” 中通过 await hook() 合理消费这些回调，从而实现资源利用的更高效。

kol.take: 模型能力仍受底层计算效率与供给约束；硬件、系统软件和推理优化共同决定可交付的速度与成本。
kol.take_en: Model economics still depend on compute efficiency and supply; hardware, systems software and inference optimization jointly determine speed and cost.
kol.take_zh: Sail 创始人 Neil Movva 提出构建“Token Factory”，针对后台长时运行的 AI 代理场景，通过软硬电全栈优化与拾荒式芯片采购，将单 Token 成本压至极致，挑战英伟达定价权与头部实验室溢价。
kol.detail: My guest today is Neil Movva, founder of Sail. Sail is building what Neil calls a token factory, an inference company designed for a specific kind of future, one where AI agents run in the background for hours or days at a time rather than answering a human in real time. In that world, latency matters less and cost matters more, and Neil has built the whole company around driving the cost of a token as low as it can possibly go. What makes this conversation special is that it is one of the most detailed tours I have ever done through the full stack of intelligence, the software, the chips, and...
kol.detail_zh: Neil Movva 是 Sail 创始人，Sail 正在构建所谓的“token factory”，即专为长时间后台运行的 AI 代理设计的推理公司。该公司的核心目标是尽可能降低单个 token 的成本，因为在这类场景中延迟不再是关键，成本才是决定因素。Sail 通过全栈优化（软件、芯片等）来实现这一极致低成本目标。

kol.take: agent 越能自主改代码，底层 runtime 越需要确定性、隔离与恢复能力；更快的生成速度反而提高了工程约束的重要性。
kol.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol.take_zh: Run SDK 推出安全 eval 功能，可在轻量 QuickJS 环境中直接执行智能体生成的代码，既无需完整沙箱，也带来更快的运行速度和更低的成本。
kol.detail: We're introducing Run SDK: secure 𝚎𝚟𝚊𝚕 for dynamic Code Mode execution. When agents write code, you don't always need a full sandbox. You can 𝚛𝚞𝚗 their code in a lightweight QuickJS secure context. Faster and more cost-efficient. 𝚗𝚙𝚖 𝚒 𝚛𝚞𝚗
kol.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 在 X 上宣布推出 Run SDK，为动态 Code Mode 执行提供安全的 eval 功能。该方案采用轻量级 QuickJS 安全上下文运行代理生成的代码，无需完整沙箱，因而更快且成本更低。开发者可通过 npm 安装指令 `npm i run` 直接使用。

kol_archive.detail: Daisy Wolf and Eva Steinman are joined by Engy Ziedan, co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Protege, to discuss why medical AI has a measurement problem, and why scoring well on a benchmark doesn't necessarily mean a model is ready for the hospital. Engy explains why healthcare AI needs independent evaluations that go beyond static exams and measure how models actually perform in real-world clinical workflows. They explore the risks of subtle bias and misalignment, why the same model can rank differently depending on how it's prompted or tested, and what happens as AI becomes more person...

kol_archive.detail: tbh this is a good debate to have. Here is what the timeline of the near past/future looks like to me: 1. Models are able to code better than I can 2. Models are able to do coding-adjacent engineering work better than I can: debugging, profiling, optimizing, bug fixing, system design, abstraction design, ui design, idea generation, etc. 3. Models are able to do most things that can be done on a computer better than most people For the kinds of coding that I do, Claude has achieved 1 and some (but not all) of 2. It is showing early-ish signs of 3. This is not the case for all coding yet. If you...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Boris Cherny 认为，AI 已在代码编写上超越他个人水平，并在调试、性能分析、优化、错误修复、系统与抽象设计、UI 设计和创意生成等编码相关工程任务上也表现更好。他指出，Claude 已实现第一阶段的能力，并在部分第二阶段任务上有所进展，显示出向全面计算机任务超越大多数人（第三阶段）迈进的早期迹象，但尚未在所有编码场景中达到此水平。

kol_archive.detail: Today's a record day for open weight share of tokens on Vercel AI Gateway. Aug 22 (today) 🟦 Open: 62% 🟨 Closed: 38% Jun 24 (~2 months ago) 🟦 Open: 28.4% 🟨 Closed: 71.6% This is very likely just the start, because enterprise adoption is still early, and harnesses, CLIs, IDEs, SDKs, etc need to be adapted to be model agnostic.
kol_archive.detail_zh: 吉列尔莫·劳赫在 X 上指出，8 月 22 日（今日）Vercel AI Gateway 的开放权重代币份额达到历史最高的 62%，封闭权重为 38%；而 6 月 24 日大约两个月前的数据为开放 28.4%，封闭 71.6%。他认为这只是开始，因为企业采用仍处于早期阶段，各类工具链（harnesses、CLI、IDE、SDK）还需进一步适配以实现模型无关。

kol_archive.detail: Thoughts About Scaling Law Scaling, but not only of parameters. Every model release now ends with the same question: how many parameters? It isn't a question that can be answered on its own. Parameter count is only meaningful alongside three others — how much data you have, where you intend to spend your compute, and who will run the model, under what conditions. The field learned this the hard way. Kaplan et al. (2020) fit an exponent that told everyone to grow parameters faster than data — roughly 2.7:1 — and the industry complied: GPT-3, Gopher, MT-NLG. Hoffmann et al. (2022) redid the expe...
kol_archive.detail_zh: 模型规模的评估不应仅关注参数量，而应综合考虑数据规模、计算资源投入以及推理环境。过去行业过度追逐参数增长（如 Kaplan 研究中建议参数与数据比例为 2.7:1），导致了 GPT-3 等模型过度堆砌参数，而 Hoffmann 等人的后续研究修正了这一认知，强调了计算效率与数据质量在 Scaling Law 中的核心地位。

A single native binary, no runtime to install. It cold starts in 10µs and does no unnecessary work or I/O before accepting input. fx is the answer to "how fast can a coding agent be?" 2. Light. The 6.3MiB binary uses single-digit megabytes of memory at baseline, made for instant installation and embedding in resource-constrained env...

kol_archive.detail: The argument that “AI structurally centralizes power” because it’s currently compute hungry ignores 125 years of super exponential growth in compute price-performance. Improvement in algorithms and continued hardware efficiency gains means there is no reason to assume AGI-level capabilities will always require a data center to run. Scaling laws are not laws of physics. kol_archive.detail: The mighty A100 fleet are mission-capable from 2020 through 2029. NVIDIA computing is more than chips. kol_archive.detail_zh: NVIDIA 强调其计算能力不仅限于芯片本身，核心竞争力在于 CUDA 平台提供的持续升级能力，使 Ampere、Hopper 及 Blackwell 等架构在整个生命周期内都能保持先进性。这种通用性使 NVIDIA 的算力具备了可替代性和高利用率，从而使其成为一种具有长期生命周期（如 A100 从 2020 年延续至 2029 年）、可租赁且可融资的生产性资产。

kol_archive.detail: A weird experiment I've been trying the last few weeks is having Claude take over day-to-day maintenance of our apps. Seeing early signs of life that this might be possible. The setup is straightforward: we have a Slack channel called proj-claude-maintains-apps. In it, Claude Tag runs a bunch of daily routines across iOS, Android, Desktop, web, CLI, and Agent SDK: - Crash fuzzer: open the app in a simulator and tap around to find ways to crash it, then root cause and fix the crashes - Dup unifier: scans the codebase for similar-yet-slightly-divergent abstractions, and puts up PRs to unify them...
